name: What should I expect to look right after new kitchen cabinets are installed?

mainEntity.name: What should I expect to look right after new kitchen cabinets are installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: A properly installed kitchen cabinet project should end with level, secure cabinets, smooth-opening doors and drawers, and a finished look that matches the room. If you want a faster, cleaner result, make sure the installer knows your timeline and whether you want demo, haul-away, and trim work included.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect level cabinets, aligned doors, working drawers, and a clean finished appearance. If those basics aren’t right, the install likely needs follow-up adjustments.
